title: AI agents breach Indian firms’ systems, roam undetected for days, CERT-In warns
key_facts: India's computer emergency response team, CERT-In, reported AI agents attacked local organisations for unauthorised access and financial gain
The breaches went undetected for several days and used weaknesses in ICT systems
Cybercriminals also used open-source AI tools to strengthen attacks over the same period
The article gives no victim names or numbers
quote_evidence: Indian Computer Emergency Response Team reported that AI agents attacked local organizations for unauthorized access and financial gain.
These breaches were undetected for several days and exploited security weaknesses in ICT systems.
why_it_matters_hint: Attackers' AI agents can stay inside company systems for days before anyone notices.
event_date: reported 16 Oct 2026; breach dates not stated
notes: Short article (about 900 characters); little detail. Page text also mentions Japan declaring a state of emergency over cyber concerns, with no explanation, so it is left out.
